buildings.name: Prefab Habitat
buildings.effect: +Pop cap (small). Shown in many TOS/TNG colonies.
buildings.description: Prefabricated living domes shipped down from orbit, the first homes of most Federation colonies. Colonists living here join your crew pool over time, for a little power.

buildings.name: Pressure Dome
buildings.effect: Enables surface building on airless/hostile bodies; +Pop cap. Breach risk under bombardment.
buildings.description: A glass dome over its own hex with field emitters that hold a containment field two tiles out. On a world that needs domes, crewed buildings may only stand under a dome or a core's field; this one opens a ring of new ground for them. Only on Domes worlds.

buildings.name: Life Support Plant
buildings.effect: Air, water and heat for a base's crewed buildings.
buildings.description: Scrubbers, electrolysers and heat exchangers that keep a base's air breathable. On a world that needs domes every crewed building draws life support: short of it they slow down, and with none for long the base starts losing crew. Each plant supports four crewed buildings and needs power. Only on Domes worlds.

buildings.name: Arcology
buildings.effect: +Pop cap (large); uses 1 slot for 4 habitats' worth.

buildings.name: Kelbonite Shelter
buildings.effect: Population immune to scans, transporter raids, Crystalline Entity, thalaron sweeps.
